inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art with bold clean storybook shapes. An overcast day under a sickly pale green sky with low green fog. Bleached bone white and ash grey limestone, cold slate shadows, green lichen, the courtyard of cool slate grey paving in a calm even mid tone. One single continuous 2.5D battle scene, no figures, no text.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand-pixelled 2D game background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair-stepped contours everywhere. Muted limited palette, flat colour clusters, two or three discrete shades per stone. Organic uneven shapes with carefully chipped corners. Broad quiet surfaces with occasional short angular cracks. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. The controlled pixel craft of an old burial court: irregular broad paving stones, shallow angular shadows, weathering only on selected edges. No paint brushwork, no gritty texture layer, no dithering, no gradients.", "aesthetics": "readable 2.5D battle stage, bleached bone and green fog, bold storybook shapes, coherent pixel clusters", "lighting": "Flat overcast light as discrete flat pixel colour planes, soft cold shadows, the fighting ground an even mid tone slate grey.", "color_palette": ["#1e2426", "#323c3e", "#505e5c", "#7a8a84", "#b4c0b6", "#e2e8dc", "#7a9a48", "#b8d080"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D side view battle stage seen from a fixed oblique camera, no figures. The upper part: the sunken crypt of Bloodridge, a ruined stone crypt doorway in the middle with heavy pillars, a broken lintel and two worn steps, its inside dark; rubble terraces and broken stairs on the left; an old wall gripped by huge twisting tree roots on the right; above them a strip of sky over a distant ridge. The lower half: one wide flat courtyard of broad worn paving stones in a calm even mid tone, quiet so small fighters in sepia rags and bronze stand out on it.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 300, 380, 660], "desc": "the ruined stone crypt doorway with heavy pillars, a broken lintel and two worn steps, dark inside"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [40, 0, 360, 310], "desc": "rubble terraces and broken stone stairs"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [30, 640, 400, 1000], "desc": "an old stone wall gripped by huge twisting tree roots"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [380, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a wide flat courtyard of broad worn paving stones in a calm even mid tone, no sepia, no orange"}]}}
